verdict.rationale: Convex documents a public HTTP API: a deployment's public functions are exposed at public HTTP endpoints that return results as values. The documented CLI (`npx convex run`, import/export, logs) adds another documented way to drive deployments programmatically. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), no evidence of a documented management/platform API for administering deployments beyond calling app functions, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage.
